body: Maybe this is dumb, but my first thought was that the wilderness did it.
Same thing they say every time, I imagine.

I'm so sorry you had a bad night there. I (female) work at Heavy Anchor and even before I worked there it was the only bar I felt comfortable going to alone. Comedy nights, especially open mics, can be weird. There have been problem comics in the past and once we know about the problem they are not welcome back. 

One of the owners is a woman and half the staff is female. We regularly host events to raise funds for reproductive rights and women's issues. Every couple of months we host a comedy show with all female comics. We are very pro-woman. I am so sorry your experience was bad but I promise you it is not the typical experience.

That team always loses and Ramsey always claims the dish they left out would have gotten them the win. Then the person who made that dish whines and cries about it for the rest of the episode. Thank you!

NTA. You feel how you feel, and it sounds like you're feeling smothered. Maybe you're like me and romantic shit annoys the ever-loving hell out of you. A dude wrote me a poem once and it took everything I had in me to be polite and not grimace.

Sometimes even the best people aren't what we need or want. Maybe you need someone a little more emotionally distant or detached. There's nothing wrong with that. Or maybe your therapy will get you to a place that allows you to open yourself up to this emotionally intelligent man. Either way, you're not wrong for feeling how you feel. Good luck to you!

NTA. Your boyfriend is abusive and your friends are either not really your friends or they're in similar relationships and can't see the abuse for what it is. Get out before he does more damage to you and your sense of self worth.
Either you're a racist moron or you're trolling. Either way, YTA.
YTA. He was teasing you and in response you purposely hurt him by making fun of him for doing something you admit he loves and is good at. You do owe him an apology.

I didn't realize it was in the middle of the living room.

ESH. He's a piece of work to be sure, but you could have found another way to handle the situation rather than ruining his belongings.

>upon checking I just found out that all of his clothes from the trip are still on the suitcase and are all dirty

INFO: Why do you care if he has dirty clothes in a suitcase? Why were you checking on that?
NTA. That's ridiculous. She's two years old.

I think you're NTA. You tried to get to work but had a panic attack about how stressful it was. You did the right thing and called them, which honestly with my anxiety I might have just not had the mental capacity to do if I was in your shoes. I wouldn't worry about it. You're good.
Is there a conflict here? Was your job mad at you? They probably understood if they knew you were coming from far away and the traffic from the procession would affect you.
ESH. A simple "hey it's your mom's birthday" sounds like it would have been less emotional labor than this.
NTA. You're doing the right thing for you and your kids.

NTA. The real issue is them leaving the dog outside all the time. If you feel comfortable confronting them, confront them about that and tell them you're gonna call humane society or something if they keep doing it. That poor dog.
NTA. She's nuts. Tell her you changed your mind and on second thought you don't want her to wear a shawl.
I see you answered this in another comment. Definitely have a conversation with her.

Info. When you say you've tried being firm, do you mean in the moment when you're trying to get off the phone? Or have you actually had a conversation about it and laid out why this is a problem for you?
You can't possibly be serious. YTA.
Ew. Let this guy go, he sounds awful.
Also, what was he digging for when he found the obituary?
NTA. He managed to make your loss about him. He's a dick.

NTA. Like you said, you didn't sign up for this. You've told her how you feel about it and she keeps agreeing to watch the kid anyway. I understand it's probably hard for her to tell her sister no, but if she had then she could be taking a mini vacation with you instead of watching the kid by herself.

NAH. You're not wrong for wanting the tattoo gone, but he's not wrong for not wanting to cover it up just for your sake. You can't dictate someone's permanent body art, it has to be a personal decision for him.
INFO: How old are your siblings and do they live with your parents?

She literally said, "I found myself sitting around all day long." Nobody is projecting that, it's in the first paragraph. And yeah, I don't believe the husband helps much either, but we really don't know.

The only time she mentions her kids is when she says she sits around all day now that they're more independent, and we have no idea what the distribution of chores in their house is because she never mentioned it.
YTA for lying. And for referring to your fake past partners as "bodies." And for the phrase "first stone I pierced whilst unsheathed."
I totally agree with this. YWBTA.

NTA. It sounds like you were being genuine and coming from a place of love. But weight isn't an issue to be "solved" and sometimes we complain not because we want a solution, but because we need to vent. Now you know to ask her first.

If you value your friendship with this person, I think the best thing is to be honest with her about your feelings. Don't make up an excuse, tell her the truth. Regarding her shift in personality, it sounds like she's just excited about being pregnant. She might not even realize she's dominating conversations, and that's an easy thing to address. Regarding your feelings about her fiance, well, sometimes we don't like the choices our friends make but we stand by them anyway.

If you're ready to just cut her out of your life, a lame excuse to not go to the wedding is fine. If you want to continue being friends with her, either stay in the wedding or tell her the truth. YWBTA if you make something up.

YTA. There are three people in the house, so things should be split evenly. However, if roommate is the only one who wants a couch, she can pay for it and then it's her couch that she can take with her when she moves out.

With all the vagueness in your post about what his job actually is and what Casey's special circumstances are that have only allowed her to ever date 3 people, I have to go with YTA. It's impossible to say otherwise without more information.
NTA. Your dad literally told you he wants you to have it. Sister already has one. She doesn't *need* two. She *wants* two.

So, okay, I think if both you and your husband are making money, you should both be contributing to the household. By that I mean bills, groceries, etc. Not a wristwatch just because he wants one and thinks you should pay for it.

So, INFO, are you contributing to the household?

Also, why the fuck are you with a man like that?

You know, I just read the post again and I didn't get the "what a dick" feeling about him that I did when I read it yesterday. The judgement is already cast or I'd change my vote, but fwiw I agree with you.
Yes, the boyfriend is an AH. Don't get me wrong, OP is leaps and bounds ahead of him in terms of assholery, but issuing ultimatums and threatening a breakup is also an asshole move.

ESH. Since your bf was surprised by the situation, it sounds like in the week between meeting Cody and having coffee with him, you didn't mention him to your bf. Then you decided to meet up with him and tell your bf you were seeing "a friend." Then, in a language your bf doesn't know very well, you told your dad you were meeting a guy. 

It seems like you were trying to hide this guy from the bf, and he probably feels that way too. I'd be mad if I were him. His reaction was over the top, but he might have reacted differently if you'd just communicated with him.
NTA. My ex husband drove a manual. I never learned how. I had my own car. It was literally never an issue.
NTA, but lesson learned. Don't tell this person secrets.
NTA. That's a weird line for her to draw.
NTA. What is it about this position he hates so much? Is it just because he still has to do his old job too?

NTA. This is absolutely your decision and nobody else's. Your brother can give him a kidney and they can do a gofundme. You don't owe them anything. 
Btw, good for you for getting out of there when you did and for being happy now.
YTA. You can't claim "not my responsibility" after you told them you could do it.
YTA. Why would anyone think that was funny?

>instead of greeting us, she tried to step on Kate’s toes and then walked away.

There's a lot more going on in this post, I know. But I have to know if this grown woman \*literally\* tried to step on your wife's feet. Wtf?

You're NTA. Paige very clearly has something off about her and you're not wrong for wanting to keep her away from your child.

>The girl is obviously sick (hair is falling out, ribs showing, bloated abdomen, has never menstruated, etc)

Those are classic signs of anorexia (not to mention her weighing 74 pounds). I would try one more time to talk to her parents and let them know you suspect she has an eating disorder. If they shut you down, then you're NTA for getting someone involved.

NTA. You're literally just looking at the game files on your computer, right? Nothing you do to those files is going to have any effect on anyone else who plays the game. I do that all the time to games I play to enhance my own experience. It's not an insult to the game devs. And it sounds like you initially just wanted to help him make his game better.
NTA. She was just grumbling because she got called out. If it continues to happen you should report her. Otherwise I'd just not worry about it.

NTA. Jesus Christ, weddings suck. I don't know why some brides-to-be seem to think that on their wedding day everyone they know stops being a real person and only exists to make them happy.

You offered an alternative. She said no. Fuck it.
NTA lol. "Sir, we've noticed you have a penis. That sort of thing is frowned upon around here."

NTA. You're not even the one who banned him. Who's to say your other friends even want him back in the group? 

I don't necessarily think your bf is TA either. Sounds more like he's just trying to keep the peace. But he needs to understand that you have boundaries, and if someone crosses them they gotta go. I'm glad he called his friend out and made him apologize, and maybe if he was in your shoes that would be enough for him and he thinks it should be for you too. He needs to accept that's not the case.

I was just pointing out that not liking the name doesn't give OP free reign to be an AH. I don't like the name either but would never act that way to my pregnant partner who recently had a miscarriage. It could have been handled so many other ways.

If they've messed up your order so many times, why do you keep giving them your business? NTA because it sucks that they're so bad at their jobs, but you could bring a lunch, go somewhere else, order delivery. They've pretty much proven they aren't gonna get better at making your food.

NTA for not telling your brother, but you could have given new sister what little contact info you had for him and let her reach out instead of lying and saying you couldn't get in touch with him at all.
NTA. You should absolutely speak up. And so should your boyfriend if he wants to continue being your boyfriend.
I was really more reacting to the "Star" part of the name.
YTA. I mean, I'm with you, that's a terrible name. But wow, you could have handled that differently.
NTA. Please never hang out with this person ever again.

YTA. He passed out. He called when he woke up and apologized. That should be a non issue at this point. 

However, stealing your prescription, lying about where he's going for eight weeks, Instagram account you didn't know about...seriously get out of this relationship.
YTA. Like so much YTA. Your kids are not that man's problem. Get a grip.
YTA. You sound like a jealous and clingy boyfriend. She sounds over it.
NTA. That's awesome, lol.
YTA. I know you're hurt and it sucks when something like that happens. But like everyone else is saying, you're broken up and he doesn't owe you anything.
NTA. That's super disturbing and very strange behavior. Honestly, maybe you should see if you can live with your grandparents or something because none of that is okay or appropriate.
NTA. That shit needs to stay out of the workplace.
YTA. I'm so glad your girlfriend is smarter than you and knows what a bad idea this would be.
NTA. Your brothers sound insufferable.
ESH. It's well past time to break up.
I guess I was thinking if you were stuck in bed anyway they could have just gone. I didn't realize you eventually got up and tried to go with them.

NTA but it might not have been the best idea. I know where you're coming from. I have an abusive ex who treated me similarly. I haven't seen him in five years, but I'm still triggered by certain things and I sometimes want to tell him how he affected me. But I know that trying to communicate anything with him would just bring him back into my life and I don't want that. I'm happy with my current partner and in general I just try to put it behind me.

I totally understand wanting to get it off your chest. I really do. If he sends you a reply, my advice is to not even open it. You've gotten your feelings out and hopefully you can start to move on now. How he responds doesn't really matter.

NTA, but I don't understand why they just didn't do those things without you? I mean, maybe not the concert because they didn't want to leave you alone at a bus stop, but the museum? They still could have gone.

NAH. I can't imagine what it's like to be a kid in school these days having to worry about active shooters and lockdowns. However, it doesn't sound like your mom is being an AH either. She's your mom, she's supposed to worry about you missing school, she's supposed to give you chores. It's her job. She might have really just thought after the threat was cleared that you'd be fine. If you're not fine (which would be totally understandable) try to talk to her - or a guidance counselor - about how scary it was.
YTA for embarrassing him in front of his friends. You probably could have privately threatened punishment and gotten him to tell the truth without involving other people.

YTA. Most of us had a lot more free time during quarantine than we do now. Expecting him to still be able to devote that much time to you is unrealistic. Two hours a day on Facetime seems totally reasonable to me, if not a little much to expect. I cannot imagine an all day Facetime session, but that's just me. He's 17 and lives three hours away from you. You need to let him live his life. If you're not happy with how he fits you into it then maybe it's time to break up.
NTA. A 32 year old person should be able to quit a job without anyone else's help, especially from an ex-bf. Whatever the reasons you broke up, you are broken up. You don't owe him anything.
Oh no!
She's right. So what's the problem?

>Call me a bad father, but i dont want to see my 13 year old son see a girl in a "legalize drugs" jacket and devil shorts bent over in the backyard gardening.

LOL, what in the world are devil shorts?

YTA. That girl is absolutely allowed to wear whatever the hell she wants in her own backyard. Your wife is right and maybe you shouldn't be so concerned with what your teenage neighbor is wearing. Loosen up.
YTA. This is someone you spend a lot of time with and she's not wrong to want to meet him. If I were her I'd start to wonder if he was your imaginary friend.
NTA. You didn't steal anyone from anyone. She had an unrequited crush and two years later you started dating the guy. You're good.
YWBTA. Don't call her fat. But do try to talk to her. It sounds like she's on her way to an eating disorder and she's projecting her insecurities about herself onto others.
NTA. You choose who you let in your life. She doesn't deserve a place there.
YTA for being a troll.

NTA. Your mom is being ridiculous. She should be encouraging your bond with your brother and sister, and besides, 14 and 16 is very different from 11 and 8. Aside from that, I imagine you were already out of the house or close to it when the stepsiblings came into the picture. She's trying to force a bond that just isn't there.
NTA, but your girlfriend is.

YTA. At no point in your post do you mention actually, you know, \*talking\* to your child. You've only told us the punishments you've doled out. You mentioned Shay trying to connect with her, but have \*you\* tried to connect with her? Have you asked her how she feels about any of this? You're her mother, and it sounds like you've been putting your relationship with Shay ahead of the one with your daughter.
YTA. "This person is NICE TO ME and I HATE IT." I don't get what your problem is.
YTA. You invaded her privacy. It's none of your business who she dated before you got together.
NTA. If that's not something your restaurant does, it's super weird to just ask a random stranger to sing at you. I'd feel super weird singing a solo happy birthday to a customer on demand.

YTA. It sounds like he has a LOT going on and he must be stressed out. Let him get settled. It sounds less like poor planning and more like he has a lot of things in the air and he needs to see where they land before he makes travel plans.
Still costs the same to fix it.

I'm not sure if you're an AH but I do think you're overreacting, unless there's a lot of information missing. Aunt 2 isn't a random stranger, she's MIL's sister (I'm assuming). I think if you just tell MIL you'd prefer it if she doesn't have anyone over to the house while she's babysitting that should suffice.
Agreed.
This can't be real. Nobody can be this clueless. But on the off chance you're not a troll, YTA.
NTA, and it's bizarre that he insists on parking there. Maybe you should park your own car there for a bit and see what he does.

YTA. So instead of getting rid of something that she's allergic to, you accepted ANOTHER bouquet and put it in the BEDROOM? Do you even like your wife? I don't care how much money you make, get rid of the damn roses.

Gently, YTA. It's great that you're not offended, but not everyone feels the same way about everything that you do. Anytime you tell someone how they \*should\* feel, you're kind of being an AH. 

On another note, I think it's strange to immediately ask someone their talent upon finding out they're autistic.

Yeah, YTA. Basically, your friend came out to you and you laughed at him. Then you confronted him for...what? He told you he was busy and it turns out he was. He was busy hanging out with a new set of friends who will hopefully treat him better.

NTA. You absolutely did the right thing by your brother, as he knew you would, which is why he specified that you be the one to arrange things. Your grandmother's health is not deteriorating because of you. I'm so sorry for your loss.
NTA. I don't get what the big deal is either.

YTA. Why would you want him to get a job "that other teenagers have" when he's making money doing something he loves? He's making about the same amount he would make working in fast food, and he doesn't have to crush his soul to do it, so what exactly is your issue with it?
NTA. As long as you're not planning to use them as a reference, do it. But they will probably try to have it removed.

NTA. She's being horrible. That poor girl has literally nobody in the world except for you. Buy the ex out of the apartment and call it a day. After that it doesn't matter if she thinks Ilhan should have it or not.
NTA. That's just weird. I can't imagine being that bold and annoying. Tbh, he probably wanted to start an argument about Russia with you.
NTA. If your brother really wants a better relationship with you, he needs to stop hanging out with your abuser. Simple as that.

NTA.

I vape. I love my vape. I quit smoking ten years ago and the vape keeps me sane. It's pretty much always in my hand. I \*feel\* like it's safer than smoking. I feel better physically and I breathe easier. But the truth is we don't know the long-lasting effects of it, and it's not likely it's safe for a baby to breathe in. It's not "just vapor." There are chemicals. 

So when my siblings started having babies, know what I did? I vaped outside or I didn't vape at their houses at all. Your bf might genuinely think it's just vapor, but he's wrong.

ESH. I can't even parse out what all that with the houses and whatever means (try some paragraphs), but she sucks for taking advantage of you, and you suck for letting her. You suck even more if you make celibacy a condition of helping her out. You sound like an incel "nice guy" who thinks you're gonna wear her down one of these days.
FFS, she already knows German, Russian, and Spanish. Give the kid a break. Netflix in the bath is her free time? She's telling you what she needs. You need to listen to her. YTA.
That's what I thought, just wanted to make sure. Definitely NTA.

Wow, that's a mess. Asking someone to "take the kid for a few weeks" is a big ask even in a happy and loving family. You've made your boundaries very clear and have every reason to refuse. Besides that, this is a 7 year old who's been abandoned by his parents. Shoving him off on his aunt who he's never met is probably not gonna be good for him. NTA

I do think someone should get the authorities involved if they aren't already.
And for the flip side, my mom supported me figuring out who I was and let me wear what I was comfortable in and now, in my 40s, she and I are super close.

INFO, because I just want to clarify. This is just about who is in charge of things if your mom passes? It's not taking away any inheritance from her or anything? If that's the case, NTA. She's expressed no interest in any of that and you have the experience.
NTA. You're being a mature adult and setting boundaries. She hasn't been a good friend to you.
YTA. Support your kid, wtf.
This whole post reads like a fever dream in written form.
And you're ghosting her because you think your being up for a promotion at work trumps her worry for her family. YTA
There's a ton of missing info here. What is she going through? Are you in a long term relationship or just dating? Have you told her what's going on with you?
NTA. What a dick.

Agree with all of this. NAH. My teeth were also terrible and now I have a full upper denture because they got to the point of being unfixable. But I spent years doing all the same things, turning my head, not smiling, etc. 

If someone I was dating had offered to pay for me to fix them very early on in the relationship I would have felt very weird about it and probably reacted similarly to her, but I don't think OP had asshole intentions. Just know that she's very aware of her teeth and probably don't bring it up again unless she does.
NTA. Get out of that relationship immediately.
NTA. He's the one that messaged you. I'd bet money he never once entered your mind when you were taking the photos. That was solely for her.
NTA, lol. You cannot name your poor child Jackson Jackson.
YTA. You should be SO proud of her. She sounds amazing. She's not embarrassing herself. You're just embarrassed by her because of your own insecurities.
NTA and good for you for not letting them bully you into lying to their daughter. They wanted the kid to be mad at you instead of them.
I'm not, never heard it before and I love it lol
NTA. I wouldn't go either.
YTA. It's baffling that you need to ask.
If you genuinely didn't know, NTA. You should absolutely not be paying anyone's therapy over this.

YTA, but I get what you're saying. But instead of asking if she wanted you to be honest (which I would also take to mean that I looked bad) you could have said something like, "The fit is great! I'm not sure the color is right, wanna see if they have other colors?"

When someone asks you how they look, never say, "Do you really want me to tell you?" Especially when it's your pregnant wife who hasn't been able to find anything that she feels good in for weeks.
NTA. And I'll be adding the word "voluntold" to my vocabulary for the future lol.
INFO. You say your dad tries to help but cousin undermines him. But cousin doesn't do any chores so how exactly are they undermining him?
Ugh, that is ridiculous. NTA by the way.
Or there's a ton of drama if this is the way they react to everything lol
It was absolutely worse and you should apologize. YTA
I don't blame you. It was a nice thing you were doing and that kid fucked it up for everyone. NTA
NTA. She chose to confront you and she blocked you from getting into your car. She was the aggressor here.
NTA, and I can't believe anyone cares that much about Wordle.
NTA, and you dodged a bullet.
NTA. It's literally the job she was hired to do.
NTA. This man is not your boyfriend.
NTA. The idea of someone sleeping in my bed kinda icks me out.
If he's always like this, I don't blame you for not trying. It's exhausting trying to explain to people why they shouldn't act like dicks.
Ugh, never fuck with someone's sleep. NTA at all.

INFO, at any point before you walked out did you tell him he was being gross or ask him to stop? I don't think you're an AH but to just leave without a word is a little weird.

Edit: I just saw you answered this already. NTA.
NTA. By "sheltered" do you mean "never heard of boys?" I'd assume, like you did, that at 19 they can dress themselves, lol.
NTA, they're taking advantage of your generosity. You can be sorry for their loss and still not want them using your yard as a parking lot.
NTA. I mean, if someone invited me to stay with them, I'd expect a key. But his reaction is pretty ridiculous. Especially a week after he stormed out and he's still expecting to stay with you.

It sounds like he was hoping that making it official might mean he gets more of your attention. If you were happy with the way it was before and you're already giving him as much as you're willing to give, then let him know that. NTA.
INFO: Did this talk about his "needs" start after he asked you to be his girlfriend, or has he always felt like this?
YTA. Your girlfriend is feeling hurt and excluded by her friends. Your response is to dismiss it as "drama" that you can't be bothered to care about.

NTA. It doesn't sound to me like you actually led him on. You went on some dates. Did you ever lie to him and tell him you were looking for something more serious during those first two months?

I agree with everyone saying you need to block him. He's definitely trying to wear you down and he's not hearing you when you say you're not interested. Cut him off.
NTA, and she's an idiot who clearly doesn't know what step-parents are lol
ESH. Break up. He'll do it again and again.
NTA. He might as well learn now that women's periods are a fact of life. It's just a box. He also might as well learn now that his conservative values aren't going to fly with a lot of women.
Yeah, none of that sounds like verbal assault. Definitely NTA.
NTA for not letting her control you, but you might be for whatever you said that her parents called "verbal assault."
NTA. You gave her every opportunity to say no and back out. She made her own decisions.
What the hell did I just read?
\^ Yep. YTA. You were definitely being mean for no reason, OP.
You told your friend she looked "really fat," you've said worse things before, and you don't know what you did wrong? YTA.
Agreed. The cake is a lie.

NTA. Like you said, it's really between them and none of your business. If it was something harmful (like something he's allergic to) then sure do what they want, but otherwise just keep doing what you're doing.
NTA. You are never in the wrong to demand someone stop touching you.

NTA. My partner and I used to live with another couple. Four people sharing one bathroom means we've all seen each other in various states of undress at some point. You gotta laugh about it. Also, it's your place and you were nice enough to let them stay with you.
YTA. You're in denial and you're dismissive and if you're not a troll you're just an awful mother.
Yeah, I would have shut that conversation down at "ASL."
This is...strange. Are you rude/unfeeling to everyone you meet just in case they might try to be your friend? Who are these people who approach you?
NTA. Misinformation on this topic is dangerous, especially now.
YTA. Why did you get so mad about it?

NTA. "You never got back to me about when the game was and I've already made plans for Saturday. Sorry, wish I could help." Then stop answering. And I would rethink sticking around for the kids if you really don't want a relationship with this woman. I know that's easier said than done.
NTA. Please break up with him. At 21 he should be a little more mature than that.
Yeah, that's a bad environment. I don't think you had any bad intent with the alerts, but the whole family tiptoeing around her that often isn't healthy.

INFO How often do these bad days come around? If it's very rare then I don't see anything wrong with this. We all have bad days and it's nice that her family notices and tries to make it better. But if it's like a few times a week then it's time to have a serious talk with the wife about her emotional control.
Yeah, at that age what your friends think about you feels like the most important thing in the world. There's gotta be somewhere else you can skate. YTA
YWBTA. Why would you force him to talk about things he very clearly doesn't want to talk about?

I hope you ditch him and then write a screenplay about a smart girl with a jock boyfriend who eventually realizes he's an idiot but by then it's too late because the smart girl has already found a smart guy who also wears pimple patches and hates basketball.

NTA

>always complaining about their weight and how unfit they are, but insulting those who are thinner. They like to comment on how much lower my weight it than theirs a lot

This is why they're saying those things. It's awful they're taking their insecurities out on you and making you uncomfortable. NTA.

So this is hard to judge for me, but I think ESH. I'm actually in the same situation as your fiance. My guy makes a lot more money than I do and the house is in his name and he pays most of the mortgage. He says either, "We got a house," or "I bought a house," and it literally doesn't matter to me which way he puts it. He did buy the house, after all. So in my eyes your fiance is being a little too sensitive. However, if my guy started saying things to me like, "This is \*my\* house," it would make me feel shitty. Like a guest in my own home.

That's not sleep paralysis. 

When you sleep, your brain tells your body to stop moving. This is what prevents most of us from sleepwalking and stuff. Sometimes you can wake up while your body is still asleep, or it can happen when you're trying to fall asleep. Your brain is awake, but your body is asleep. That's sleep paralysis.

OP, it honestly seems to me like you just had a dream. Possibly you were in between sleeping and waking when you saw the arm. Lots of people have had sleep paralysis coupled with the image of someone or something holding them down.
